answer: The identity then has to pass a pearl challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next knoll. Registration requires a proof of work of 25 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the wander. Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent pays only once. Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. That is 10 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
